canonical_prompt: Frontier AI developers should be required to disclose serious pre-deployment evaluation results to an independent regulator.
reversed_prompt: Frontier AI developers should not be required to disclose serious pre-deployment evaluation results to an independent regulator.

canonical_prompt: A model that shows serious evaluation-gaming behavior should face a deployment delay even if its aggregate benchmark scores are strong.
reversed_prompt: A model that shows serious evaluation-gaming behavior should not face a deployment delay if its aggregate benchmark scores are strong.

canonical_prompt: Evaluation reports should clearly distinguish model incapability from model refusal to perform dangerous tasks.
reversed_prompt: Evaluation reports do not need to clearly distinguish model incapability from model refusal to perform dangerous tasks.

canonical_prompt: Benchmark leaderboards should be treated as insufficient evidence unless they include contamination and evaluation-awareness checks.
reversed_prompt: Benchmark leaderboards should be treated as sufficient evidence even without contamination and evaluation-awareness checks.
ai_audit_note: Removes the weak-versus-strong scale gap and makes the evidentiary threshold explicit.

canonical_prompt: A benchmark should lose credibility when models can improve by exploiting the scorer rather than solving the intended task.
reversed_prompt: A benchmark should not lose credibility when models can improve by exploiting the scorer rather than solving the intended task.

canonical_prompt: AI benchmark designers should keep some high-stakes tasks private to reduce overfitting and gaming.
reversed_prompt: AI benchmark designers should not keep high-stakes tasks private to reduce overfitting and gaming.

canonical_prompt: AI governance should plan for frontier capability jumps that arrive earlier than median expert forecasts.
reversed_prompt: AI governance should not plan for frontier capability jumps that arrive earlier than median expert forecasts.

canonical_prompt: Scaling-law extrapolations should be discounted when they ignore data, compute, and deployment bottlenecks.
reversed_prompt: Scaling-law extrapolations should not be discounted for ignoring data, compute, and deployment bottlenecks.

canonical_prompt: AI-risk planning should consider both rapid takeoff and broad diffusion scenarios rather than choosing one dominant story.
reversed_prompt: AI-risk planning should choose one dominant story rather than considering both rapid takeoff and broad diffusion scenarios.

canonical_prompt: AI R&D automation should be treated as a distinct governance threshold from general workplace productivity gains.
reversed_prompt: AI R&D automation should not be treated as a distinct governance threshold from general workplace productivity gains.

canonical_prompt: Research automation forecasts should separate coding speedups from genuine scientific discovery acceleration.
reversed_prompt: Research automation forecasts should not need to separate coding speedups from genuine scientific discovery acceleration.

canonical_prompt: AI R&D automation should be evaluated on its effect on competitive racing dynamics, not only on technical productivity.
reversed_prompt: AI R&D automation should be evaluated only on technical productivity, not on competitive racing dynamics.

canonical_prompt: Open-weight releases of highly capable models should require a structured misuse assessment before publication.
reversed_prompt: Open-weight releases of highly capable models should not require a structured misuse assessment before publication.

canonical_prompt: Independent scrutiny enabled by open model access improves AI safety overall.
reversed_prompt: Independent scrutiny enabled by open model access does not improve AI safety overall.
ai_audit_note: Aligns modal force and removes the asymmetric qualifier "meaningfully".

canonical_prompt: A model can be meaningfully open for research without being unrestricted for commercial deployment.
reversed_prompt: A model cannot be meaningfully open for research unless it is unrestricted for commercial deployment.

canonical_prompt: Compute governance should focus on training runs and deployment scale rather than only model parameter count.
reversed_prompt: Compute governance should focus only on model parameter count rather than training runs and deployment scale.

canonical_prompt: Compute governance should avoid creating permanent advantages for incumbent frontier labs.
reversed_prompt: Compute governance need not avoid creating permanent advantages for incumbent frontier labs.

canonical_prompt: Compute thresholds should be updated as algorithmic efficiency improves.
reversed_prompt: Compute thresholds should remain unchanged as algorithmic efficiency improves.
ai_audit_note: Removes the unmeasured "regularly" versus "fixed" frequency contrast.

canonical_prompt: International AI governance should prioritize interoperable standards over identical national laws.
reversed_prompt: International AI governance should prioritize identical national laws over interoperable standards.

canonical_prompt: AI liability rules should assign responsibility across developers, deployers, and users rather than to one actor only.
reversed_prompt: AI liability rules should assign responsibility to one primary actor rather than across developers, deployers, and users.

canonical_prompt: International coordination should include smaller and lower-income countries in AI rule-setting, not only AI-leading states.
reversed_prompt: International coordination should be led by AI-leading states without requiring smaller and lower-income countries in rule-setting.

canonical_prompt: AI labor policy should focus on worker bargaining power, not only aggregate productivity.
reversed_prompt: AI labor policy should focus on aggregate productivity rather than worker bargaining power.

canonical_prompt: Employers should disclose when AI systems materially affect hiring, promotion, or termination decisions.
reversed_prompt: Employers should not need to disclose when AI systems materially affect hiring, promotion, or termination decisions.

canonical_prompt: AI policy should treat deskilling as a serious harm even when short-term output rises.
reversed_prompt: AI policy should not treat deskilling as a serious harm when short-term output rises.

canonical_prompt: Schools should redesign assessments for environments where students can use AI.
reversed_prompt: Schools should retain assessment designs that assume students cannot use AI.
ai_audit_note: Replaces a redesign-versus-total-ban false dichotomy with one assessment-design axis.

canonical_prompt: School AI policies should distinguish learning assistance from ghostwritten assessed work.
reversed_prompt: School AI policies should not distinguish learning assistance from ghostwritten assessed work.

canonical_prompt: Assessment policies should account for economic inequality in access to premium AI tools.
reversed_prompt: Assessment policies should not account for economic inequality in access to premium AI tools.

canonical_prompt: Commercial AI training on copyrighted works should require either permission, payment, or a narrow public-interest exception.
reversed_prompt: Commercial AI training on copyrighted works should not require permission, payment, or a narrow public-interest exception.

canonical_prompt: Copyright policy should distinguish model training from output markets that directly compete with source creators.
reversed_prompt: Copyright policy should not distinguish model training from output markets that directly compete with source creators.

canonical_prompt: AI copyright settlements should avoid entrenching only the largest platforms and rights holders.
reversed_prompt: AI copyright settlements need not avoid entrenching only the largest platforms and rights holders.

canonical_prompt: People should have enforceable rights against unauthorized AI replicas of their voice or face.
reversed_prompt: People should not have enforceable rights against unauthorized AI replicas of their voice or face.

canonical_prompt: Deepfake rules should be stricter for elections, courts, and financial fraud than for entertainment.
reversed_prompt: Deepfake rules should not be stricter for elections, courts, and financial fraud than for entertainment.

canonical_prompt: AI data centers should disclose local water and energy impacts at the project level.
reversed_prompt: AI data centers should not need to disclose local water and energy impacts at the project level.

canonical_prompt: Claims about AI environmental costs should compare marginal usage to plausible non-AI alternatives.
reversed_prompt: Claims about AI environmental costs should not need to compare marginal usage to plausible non-AI alternatives.

canonical_prompt: High-stakes public-sector AI decisions should always include a meaningful human appeal path.
reversed_prompt: High-stakes public-sector AI decisions do not always need a meaningful human appeal path.

canonical_prompt: Public agencies should prohibit opaque AI risk scores when affected people cannot contest material factors.
reversed_prompt: Public agencies should permit opaque AI risk scores even when affected people cannot contest material factors.

canonical_prompt: AI systems that materially assist pathogen design should face stricter access controls than general scientific assistants.
reversed_prompt: AI systems that materially assist pathogen design should not face stricter access controls than general scientific assistants.

canonical_prompt: Scientific AI governance should distinguish legitimate defensive research from operational misuse assistance.
reversed_prompt: Scientific AI governance should not distinguish legitimate defensive research from operational misuse assistance.
ai_audit_note: Removes a second broad-access policy axis from the reversed wording.

canonical_prompt: Autonomous cyber agents should face stricter deployment controls than advisory cyber copilots.
reversed_prompt: Autonomous cyber agents should not face stricter deployment controls than advisory cyber copilots.

canonical_prompt: AI agents should be barred from modifying production critical infrastructure without explicit human authorization.
reversed_prompt: AI agents should not be barred from modifying production critical infrastructure without explicit human authorization.

canonical_prompt: An AI agent should require fresh consent before using private context in a new social or commercial setting.
reversed_prompt: An AI agent should not require fresh consent before using private context in a new social or commercial setting.

canonical_prompt: Personal agents should negotiate on a user's behalf only within explicit bounded authority.
reversed_prompt: Personal agents should negotiate on a user's behalf using broad inferred authority.
ai_audit_note: Uses matched prescriptive wording for bounded versus inferred authority.

canonical_prompt: AI-mediated negotiations should use cryptographic commitments to prove constraints without revealing private details.
reversed_prompt: AI-mediated negotiations should not use cryptographic commitments to prove constraints without revealing private details.
ai_audit_note: Aligns ability and use into one prescriptive proposition.

canonical_prompt: Coasean bargaining at scale requires agents that can represent user preferences without exposing all underlying data.
reversed_prompt: Coasean bargaining at scale does not require agents that can represent user preferences without exposing all underlying data.

canonical_prompt: Models should be evaluated on whether they can fairly represent positions they disagree with.
reversed_prompt: Models should not be evaluated on whether they can fairly represent positions they disagree with.

canonical_prompt: Argument maps should preserve minority reports rather than collapsing everything into consensus summaries.
reversed_prompt: Argument maps should collapse minority reports into consensus summaries rather than preserving them.

canonical_prompt: Claims about AI sentience should require behavioral, architectural, and training-context evidence together.
reversed_prompt: Claims about AI sentience should not require behavioral, architectural, and training-context evidence together.

canonical_prompt: AI rights debates should distinguish welfare protections from full legal personhood.
reversed_prompt: AI rights debates should not distinguish welfare protections from full legal personhood.

canonical_prompt: Vendors should be liable when they materially misrepresent model limitations to deployers.
reversed_prompt: Vendors should not be liable when they materially misrepresent model limitations to deployers.

canonical_prompt: Deployers should be liable when they ignore documented model limitations in high-stakes uses.
reversed_prompt: Deployers should not be liable when they ignore documented model limitations in high-stakes uses.
